verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a law firm could publish entity-choice and incorporation-jurisdiction guidance. The pack shows no such published guidance, whether comparing Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, GmbH/UG or Indian Pvt Ltd, or covering market-appropriate structuring. There is an India Corporate Law blog hub, general startup advisory, and a Prarambh incubator that helps already-registered businesses 'set up', but none of this shows entity-type or jurisdiction-selection guidance.
